notes.title: Text and Sound Update
notes.content:
-We put in sound effects for the guns and a button to mute it.
-We enlarged a lot of the text.  Playing on laptops and smaller screens it was harder to read the text.
-Made the controller more sensitive.  Next patch we're going to put in an option for players to manually adjust the deadpoint.
-Fixed some minor bugs.
